abi.record_ownership: only exported service record storage; arbitrary pointers rejected

pc88va_machine_init.failure: readiness is not committed; public records invalidated; no hardware rollback needed because no controller was reprogrammed
pc88va_machine_init.repeat: reject once an attempt has started

pc88va_memory_query.interval_format: u32 begin, u32 exclusive end, u16 usable
pc88va_memory_query.policy: reserve prefix and suffix; only the linked kernel-owned arena is usable

pc88va_interrupts_init.vector_policy: nonzero accepted M09 Text BIOS vector; snapshot and compare complete IVT
pc88va_interrupts_init.pic_policy: read and compare both inherited masks; never program modes, masks or EOI
pc88va_interrupts_init.failure: return unavailable without IVT or controller writes

pc88va_clock_read.read_policy: validate modeled status; first sample establishes zero, subsequent calls wait low then high before committing
pc88va_clock_read.progress: first valid source sample establishes origin zero without claiming progress; each subsequent successful call observes an edge and advances exactly one
pc88va_clock_read.atomicity: IF clear and explicit non-reentrant busy guard
pc88va_clock_read.failure: stuck source or invalid preconditions leaves counter and record unchanged

pc88va_fatal_stop_request.stop_evidence: repeated guest HLT fetch with IF clear; timeout or host marker alone rejected

public_provenance.precedent: accepted M08 loader and M09 Text BIOS wrapper, not PC-98 machine behavior
